title: Scalar Gaussian MXFP8 Quantized Training
intuition: Trains N(2, 0.5^2) using Blackwell-format MXFP8 software-reference quantization across forward pass (FPROP), activation gradients (DGRAD), and weight gradients (WGRAD), testing numerical stability under 8-bit floating point.
failure_mode: Micro-secant perturbations that fall below floating-point ULP or unscaled second-order ops round to zero, produce gradient collapse, or cause variance drift under MXFP8.
protocol_notes: Tier-1 stretch benchmark using emulated MXFP8 Linear layers; native Blackwell hardware kernel parity remains separate.
